translations.web: Through you, will we push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.
translations.bsb: Through You we repel our foes; through Your name we trample our enemies.
translations.kjv: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up
